tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check that confirms the FXMacroData API and MCP server are reachable. Returns the API health response.

tools.name: mcp_capabilities
tools.description: Explains what the FXMacroData MCP server can do: which tools render MCP Apps, which return plain rows, what is public versus subscriber-only, and how tool selection differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, and plain MCP clients. Suited to questions about what is available, why visuals are not

tools.name: subscribe_for_mcp_access
tools.description: Returns FXMacroData subscription options and a direct checkout path for unlocking MCP app visuals, charts, and advanced analytical tools.

tools.name: data_catalogue
tools.description: List every macroeconomic indicator FXMacroData publishes for a currency, with units, frequency, and coverage/freshness metadata. tools.name: risk_sentiment

Suited to cross-asset regime context for high-beta, safe-haven, commodity, or USD-defensive FX

tools.name: macro_news

tools.name: event_predictions

tools.name: latest_announcements

tools.name: press_releases
tools.description: Return the public central-bank press-release archive for a currency as the original official release rows, without derived sentiment or indicator classifications. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: rate_curve
tools.description: Return official government-nominal curve nodes, slopes, or derived forward segments for one currency. This is a subscriber data tool and preserves the endpoint's requested view and method metadata. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: rate_differentials
tools.description: Return the stored or derived rate differential for one FX pair, with the measure, rate type, curve family, and tenor metadata that define it. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: forex

tools.name: seasonality
tools.description: Get monthly return seasonality for an FX pair or XAU/USD, covering seasonal patterns, month-of-year tendency, historical monthly win rate, and XAUUSD/gold seasonality. Returns monthly average return, median return, win rate, sample size, dispersion, and per-year monthly returns from stored FX or gol

tools.name: indicator_query

Rows contain `date` (reference period), numeric `val` and separate publication evidence; no chart metadata. `as_of` selects historically eligible values; current values may include revisions. tools.name: plot_visual_artifact
tools.description: Build a generic MCP Apps chart: single or multi-series charts, including actual-vs-consensus views combining announcements with predictions. Rate-differential plots show both policy rates and their spread. Charts FXMacroData data only; no arbitrary URLs or custom code. Access: USD keyless; others: s

tools.name: macro_briefing_task
tools.description: Build a compact macro briefing for a currency by combining catalogue, key macro series, release-calendar, prediction, news, risk-sentiment, COT, seasonality, and FX technical context. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: indicator_intel_task
tools.description: Build an intelligence pack for one indicator by combining chart-ready series data, derived analytics, and nearest release timing context. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: pair_intel_task
tools.description: Build an intelligence pack for an FX pair by combining policy-rate spread context, spot-rate context, and release-timing metadata. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: macro_heatmap_task
tools.description: Build a cross-currency macro heatmap from indicator time series and return a matrix with latest values, recent changes, and z-scores.

tools.name: policy_scenario_modeler_task
tools.description: Run a policy-rate spread what-if scenario for an FX pair and estimate directional spot impact using an explicit heuristic elasticity assumption. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: macro_war_room_task
tools.description: Build a multi-panel macro market cockpit that combines FX sessions, upcoming release queue, pair context, and generated risk alerts. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: geopolitical_history
tools.description: Stored official maritime, sanctions and conflict-zone records, explicit date basis and revision history. Subscriber access.

tools.name: geopolitical_event
tools.description: One original-source event with separate incident, publication and capture dates.

tools.name: geopolitical_event_revisions
tools.description: Bounded source-record revisions available by a historical cutoff.

tools.name: geopolitical_sources
tools.description: Stored source counts, collection outcomes and coverage limits.

tools.name: geopolitical_event_reaction
tools.description: Precomputed event reference-price context; association is not causation or a trading signal.

tools.name: event_impact_replay_task
tools.description: Replay verified publication events against measured 1, 5 and 20-observation FX reference returns. Daily windows exclude the publication-day fixing; changes from previous actuals are not consensus surprises. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: quant_scenario_lab_task
tools.description: Run an expanded quant-style policy scenario for an FX pair with deterministic projection, stress percentiles, and horizon assumptions. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: macro_regime_classifier_task
tools.description: Classify a currency's macro regime using policy rate, inflation, GDP, and unemployment context, with explicit assumptions and confidence notes. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: release_risk_score_task
tools.description: Score upcoming releases for a currency pair using release-calendar proximity and indicator-level heuristics. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: portfolio_risk_engine_task
tools.description: Analyze a multi-position FX book for concentration, stress exposure, and event-driven catalyst risk. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: fx_trade_setup_task
tools.description: Build a trader-oriented FX pair setup using spot context, macro differentials, upcoming catalyst risk, and optional COT positioning. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: fx_backtest_task
tools.description: Run a spot-only FX backtest using historical policy-rate-differential and/or lagged momentum signals. Downloads complete histories, verifies vintages and price coverage, and charges opening, rebalancing and closing costs. The carry signal does not include funding income or broker rollover. Access: k

tools.name: research_run_list
tools.description: List owned saved studies. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_read
tools.description: Read one saved study; full report is available in the Research App. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_submit
tools.description: Queue one bounded research calculation; returns a queued run ID. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a saved research job. Cancellation cannot be undone; completed work may need a new submission. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_run_reveal_holdout
tools.description: Irreversibly expose a study holdout and record its exposure. The holdout can no longer be treated as unseen. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_list
tools.description: List owned reference paper accounts. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_read
tools.description: Read one reference paper account and its versions. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_start
tools.description: Create a new reference paper account starting flat at USD 100. Replay is historical.  Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_start_version
tools.description: Archive the current version and start a fresh immutable version flat at USD 100. Discards its active position and pending order without a synthetic closing fill; preserves history. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_events
tools.description: Read paged paper event summaries; full input evidence remains in the private audit export. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_pause
tools.description: Pause new paper entries. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_resume
tools.description: Resume paper entries unless risk halted. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_flatten
tools.description: Request paper position flattening and discard pending orders; this changes simulated account state. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_archive
tools.description: Archive a paper account and its active version. This account cannot be resumed. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_journal
tools.description: Read five journal notes per offset, with long text explicitly shortened. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_append_journal
tools.description: Append a version-linked journal note; does not modify existing notes. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: research_paper_revise_journal
tools.description: Append a new revision of an existing journal note, retaining the previous revisions. Paid, owner-only. No live orders or model inference. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: macro_research_pack_task
tools.description: Bundles catalogue, indicator history, next release timing, and optional FX pair context into one persistent-host-friendly research payload. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: market_sessions
tools.description: Returns which FX trading sessions are currently open (Sydney, Tokyo, London, New York) and when the next session opens or closes, for questions such as 'is the market open?', 'when does London open?', or 'which sessions overlap right now?'. An ISO-8601 UTC timestamp in `at` returns the snapshot for

tools.name: cot_data
tools.description: Get weekly CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) positioning data for a currency's FX futures contract on the CME, covering speculator positioning, non-commercial longs vs shorts, hedge-fund FX positioning, and sentiment extremes. Returns weekly snapshots with long/short open interest by trader category.

tools.name: commodities
tools.description: Get historical price series for supported commodity indicators using the exact slugs advertised by this schema. Requires an API key. Supported indicators: crude_oil_inventories, distillate_inventories, gasoline_inventories, gold, natural_gas, natural_gas_storage, oil_brent, oil_wti, platinum, silver

tools.name: catalogue_search
tools.description: Find public macro indicator series, publishers, explicit country links or organisation references. Search by text or filter by currency, country code, or publisher ID. Empty results do not establish missing data coverage. Results include stable IDs and exact next-tool arguments; no observation value

tools.name: catalogue_related
tools.description: Follow evidence-linked catalogue relationships from a node ID returned by catalogue_search. Depth is one or two, limit is at most fifty; use the returned cursor for more results. Paths explain recorded metadata relationships, not causality or series equivalence. Retrieval tools enforce their existin

tools.name: organisation_search
tools.description: Find publication-cleared FX industry organisations by name or service, optionally within a business category. Returns at most ten directory references with canonical citation URLs; does not rank firms or export the database. Access: public directory references, no API key required.

tools.name: organisation_profile
tools.description: Read one sourced public organisation summary by slug, including services, original sources and a canonical FXMacroData citation URL. Directory references carry no claim of regulatory approval or endorsement. No claim evidence or contact records are returned. Access: one public organisation summary,

tools.name: official_datasets
tools.description: One reader for the official datasets outside the headline indicators. `family` picks the set: financial_prices (government yield curves, securities, overnight benchmarks; by currency), native_history (gold ownership and custody, Treasury auctions, cash and debt, TIC positions, EIA energy; by source

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: risk_sentiment, indicator_query, geopolitical_history, geopolitical_event_revisions, research_run_reveal_holdout, research_paper_events, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, catalogue_search, catalogue_related, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve, research_run_submit · Destructive: policy_scenario_modeler_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run_list, research_run_read, research_run_submit, research_run_cancel, research_run_reveal_holdout, research_paper_append_journal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: risk_sentiment, indicator_query, geopolitical_history, geopolitical_event_revisions, research_run_reveal_holdout, research_paper_events, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, catalogue_search, catalogue_related, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve, research_run_submit · Destructive: policy_scenario_modeler_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run_list, research_run_read, research_run_submit, research_run_cancel, research_run_reveal_holdout, research_paper_append_journal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
